title: Tofu scramble on toast
steps: Chop the onion and tomato. Drain the tofu and pat it dry.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and fry the onion for 3 to 4 minutes until soft.
Crumble in the tofu, add a pinch of turmeric, salt and pepper and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until hot.
Stir in the spinach and tomato until the spinach wilts. Meanwhile toast the bread.
Serve the scramble on the toast.
